script_parts.opening: Namaste, Laxmi Impex se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — dekh raha hoon ki pichle poore 30 din mein aapke account par ek bhi enquiry nahi aayi aur aap platform par zero active days rahe, toh seedha baat karna zaroori laga.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, mujhe samajhna hai — kya aapko lagta hai ki aapke products ki demand hi market mein kam ho gayi hai, ya aapko IndiaMART par kuch technical dikkat aa rahi hai jaise catalog update nahi hua ya settings mein koi issue hai?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important cheez share karta hoon — aapka Catalog Quality Score abhi sirf 37 hai, jo ki 100 mein se bahut critical level par hai; iska seedha matlab hai ki jab bhi koi buyer aapke product type search karta hai, aapka listing upar nahi aata aur buyers aapko simply find hi nahi kar paate.
script_parts.action: Toh abhi is call par hi ek kaam karte hain — main aapka catalog open karta hoon aur aap mujhe batao ki aapke top 2-3 products kaunse hain, hum unki images, description aur pricing turant update karte hain taaki CQS score improve ho aur visibility badhne lage.
script_parts.close: Bhai ji, aaj sirf catalog ke 2-3 products fix kar lete hain — koi bada commitment nahi, bas ek chota step; agar agle 2 hafte mein bhi koi enquiry nahi aati toh hum dobara baat karenge aur agle option dekhenge, theek hai?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with someone from Laxmi Impex? I'm calling from IndiaMART — I can see that over the last 30 days your account has had zero enquiries and zero active days on the platform, so I felt it was important to reach out directly.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to understand your situation better — do you feel the demand for your products has genuinely dried up in the market, or is it more that you've been facing some issue on the platform side, like the catalog not being updated or some settings not configured correctly?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's one critical data point — your Catalog Quality Score is currently just 37 out of 100, which is at a critical level; this directly means that when buyers search for your product category, your listing is not ranking high enough for them to find you, so the lead flow problem is largely a visibility problem.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one concrete thing right now on this call — I'll pull up your catalog and you tell me your top 2 or 3 products, and we'll update their images, description, and pricing together right now so your CQS score starts improving and your listings become discoverable again.
script_parts_en.close: No big commitment today, Bhai ji — let's just fix those 2-3 product listings right now, and if enquiries still don't pick up in the next 2 weeks, we'll reconnect and look at what other options make sense for you, fair enough?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
